note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor–patient conversation)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format as supplied

What I will deliver after receiving the data:
- A structured SOAP Clinical Note with the exact headings:
  - Subjective
  - Objective
  - Assessment & Plan
    - Issue 1 (name only) with:
      - Assessment, DDx (only if consistent with the transcript; include “conflict noted” if applicable)
      - Investigations
      - Treatment
      - Referrals
    - Issue 2 (and more as applicable)
  - Quality checks (bottom of note)

Key rules I will follow:
- Treat the transcript as the primary source of factual information.
- Use the DDx only to enrich reasoning and present differential diagnoses for an issue only if consistent with the transcript. If conflicts exist, I will present both and mark “conflict noted.”
- Extract only clinically relevant information (presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, allergies, social history, physical findings, working diagnosis, DDx consistency, management/treatment/follow-up).
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- All content will be in American English, concise, and professional.
- No invented data (e.g., vitals or lab values) beyond what appears in the transcript or DDx.

If you can paste the transcript and the DDx now, I’ll generate the note immediately. If the content is long, you can paste in sections or attach them, and I’ll process accordingly.
